test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 15 July 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the highlighted idiom.

My mother is** in raptures **over her new stove.
solution:
The correct answer is **extremely delighted**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Point__**

 
• A idiom refers to **a group of words containing a meaning different from its syntactical meaning**.
 
• The phrase “**in raptures”** means **happy or ****delighted over something**.
